items.prompt:
Read.

The proud lion ignored the mouse, who later freed him from a net.

The theme is:
A) even the small can help
B) lions are strong
C) mice are fast
items.answer: A) even the small can help

solution.answer: A) even the small can help

items.prompt:
An OBJECTIVE summary:
A) states key events without opinion
B) adds your judgment
C) is very long
items.answer: A) states key events without opinion

solution.answer: A) states key events without opinion

items.prompt:
A theme is usually a statement about:
A) life or people
B) page count
C) the author's age

Read.

Omar struggled alone for months, then succeeded only after accepting his sister's help.

The theme is:
A) always work alone
B) accepting help leads to success
C) sisters are annoying
items.answer: B) accepting help leads to success

steps: Plot turn shows theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) accepting help leads to success

items.prompt:
Which is an OBJECTIVE summary of that passage?
A) Foolish Omar wasted months being stubborn before wisely getting help.
B) Omar struggled alone until he accepted his sister's help and then succeeded.
C) This is a touching, beautiful story.
items.answer: B) Omar struggled alone until he accepted his sister's help and then succeeded.

steps: No opinion words. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Omar struggled alone until he accepted his sister's help and then succeeded.

items.prompt:
A theme DEVELOPS through:
A) the characters' choices and the plot
B) only the last word
C) the cover art
items.answer: A) the characters' choices and the plot

solution.answer: A) the characters' choices and the plot

items.prompt:
Read.

The ambitious senator betrayed his closest ally to gain power, then found himself alone and distrusted, undone by the very allies he had wronged.

The BEST theme is:
A) Ambition is always good.
B) Betrayal for power can destroy the betrayer.
C) Senators work hard.
items.answer: B) Betrayal for power can destroy the betrayer.

steps: Plot resolves to show the theme. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Betrayal for power can destroy the betrayer.

items.prompt:
Which sentence does NOT belong in an objective summary?
A) The knight defeated the dragon.
B) The knight bravely and heroically slew the terrifying beast in an epic, unforgettable battle.
C) The knight returned to the castle.
items.answer: B) The knight bravely and heroically slew the terrifying beast in an epic, unforgettable battle.

steps: Loaded opinion words. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) The knight bravely and heroically slew the terrifying beast in an epic, unforgettable battle.
